versionRationale: Acceptance corpus 1.0.1 corrects EXACT-NEGOTIATION to use the versioned PDF profile signature, including its qualification digest, and separately checks a mismatched signature. Unknown and mismatched profiles remain incompatible; an exact unqualified profile remains unavailable. Synthetic golden envelope, IR, result and source bytes are unchanged; no PDF extraction qualification is inferred. Qualified dependency upgrade to Torch 2.13.0+cpu, Torchvision 0.28.0+cpu and pypdfium2 5.15.2 changes parser identity only: all 12 PDF/OCR IR semantics were independently equal, and fresh sandbox plus PHP persistence validated the new identities. Rebind cross-suite references without changing authored workload or outcome expectations.
provenance: Project-authored synthetic fixtures with reused P6.1 golden wire. The parser signature alone is reused from the project-authored PDF golden unicode-label.ir.json; no PDF, Docling, OCR or remote adapter qualification is established by this group.
